sentences.text: There is no dispute regarding passing of the award dated 02.02.2023 under Section 28A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by the Land Acquisition Officer, Gondia in which compensation of Rs.38,31,395/- has been awarded to the petitioner.
The only grievance is that the payment has not been done on the ground that grants have not been received.
2. Learned AGP on instructions makes a statement that the payment shall be made within a period of three months from today.
3. Accepting which, the petition is disposed of in terms of the aforesaid statement.

The only grievance is that the payment has not been done on the ground that grants have not been received.
